description: A Python script that launches a local HTTP server to serve a route index page for a React app, facilitating quick access to key routes via a web interface. It includes server setup, HTML generation, and browser automation.

classes.name: RouteLink
classes.description: Data class representing a route link with a name and path.

methods.name: _build_index_html
methods.description: Constructs the HTML for the route launcher index page.

methods.name: _escape_html
methods.description: Escapes special HTML characters in a string.

methods.name: _try_bind_server
methods.description: Attempts to bind a TCP server on a specified port.

methods.name: _find_available_port
methods.description: Finds an available port within a specified range and returns the server and port.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to start the server, open the browser, and keep the server running.
